comment: Stage 2 debt — a ratchet that only goes down. These case files have no canonical_request because the pure build/parse model cannot express them; spec/SCOPE.md declares openai.computer_use OUT OF 1.0 SCOPE (needs a new part type via MAP-1 amendment); gemini.cached_content was burned down 2026-09-02 — superseded by the cache surface (gemini.cache, gemini.cache_resource; MAP-6). They stay reachable via config.extensions/provider_data with no contract guarantee. Burn rule unchanged: remove each id in the same commit that attaches its canonical_request. tools/audit.py hard-fails on any NEW orphan not listed here and on any STALE entry whose case has gained a canonical_request.
body_dirs_comment: Body directories for PROVISIONAL surfaces that have live receipts (changes/ entry) but no case files because the surface has no harness direction yet. Burn rule: remove each entry in the same commit that adds its case file; the audit hard-fails on stale entries.
